title: Product video
description: Turn product photos into a storyboard, AI clips and an editable final video.
noWorkspace: Choose a workspace to create a video.

recipeHelp.auto: Match one of three recipes to your requirements and available photos.
recipeHelp.review: Focus on the design and the features you provide.
recipeHelp.unboxing: Use a real packaging photo, or approve generic packaging below.
recipeHelp.product_showcase: Highlight the product, details and call to action.

factsPlaceholder: Materials, dimensions, confirmed features or offers…
factsHelp: Only your supplied facts are used; product benefits are not inferred from a photo.
reviewScriptPlaceholder: One spoken line per scene. For example: Let's unbox AMBER Demo…
reviewScriptHelp: Enter exactly {{count}} lines, up to 18 words each. Speech uses Veo's source audio; enable Keep source clip audio. Leave blank for no narration.
requirements: What should the video look like?
imageHelp: JPG/PNG, up to 10 MB and 20 megapixels each. Images are stored privately within your workspace.
genericBox: Allow simple generic packaging when no box photo is supplied. It will not represent the actual product packaging.
musicHelp: Original BrandHub library music, licensed CC0. No automatic music loop or generated voiceover.
planHelp: This step does not generate videos, reserve or charge credits.
storyboardEmpty: Enter a brief and choose photos to review scenes, prompts and total credits before generation.

missing.reviewScriptLineCount: Use exactly 2 spoken lines for 15 seconds, or 3 for 20 seconds; one line per scene.
missing.reviewScriptTooLong: Shorten each spoken line to 18 words or fewer to leave room for delivery and transitions.
missing.reviewScriptNeedsAudio: Enable Keep source clip audio to retain the review, or clear the review script for a video without narration.
missing.productImage: Add a product photo before this storyboard can be generated.
missing.packagingImageOrConsent: A packaging photo or approval for generic packaging is required.
missing.default: Complete the recipe inputs and update the storyboard.
missing.PACKAGING_IMAGE_REQUIRED: A packaging photo or approval for generic packaging is required.
missing.packaging_image: A packaging photo or approval for generic packaging is required.

providerUnavailable: Video generation is not configured. You can review and edit the storyboard; no credits can be reserved and no clips can start yet.
editsRequirePlan: You have made changes. Update the storyboard and quote before approving generation.
quoteExpired: This quote expired. Update the storyboard for a new quote.
consentHelp: Click to reserve credits for the approved scenes. Successful scenes are charged; retrying a failed scene requires an additional approved quote.
unknownHelp: The submitted request is being reconciled. Credits remain reserved and no additional paid generation is submitted automatically.
retryHelp: Successful clips are retained. Only the selected scene will be regenerated.
renderRetryHelp: Source clips are retained. Rendering again does not generate Veo clips or add generation credits.
sourcesRetained: Reload this page to resume viewing progress. Successful scenes remain saved.
resultError: The final video could not be loaded. Please retry.
editHelp: Open the project to edit clips, text, logo and music. Saved manual edits are preserved when reopening.

errors.PRODUCT_VIDEO_SCHEMA_NOT_READY: Product video is not enabled on the server yet. Apply the feature migration before planning videos.
errors.PRODUCT_VIDEO_CONFIG_UNAVAILABLE: Veo or the renderer is not ready. Your storyboard is retained and no new credits are reserved.
errors.PRODUCT_VIDEO_STALE_PLAN: The storyboard changed. Refresh status before continuing.
errors.PRODUCT_VIDEO_STALE_QUOTE: The quote changed or expired. Update the storyboard to approve a new quote.
errors.PRODUCT_VIDEO_INVALID_ASSET: A reference image is invalid or does not belong to this private project. Choose the image again and update the storyboard.
errors.PRODUCT_VIDEO_INVALID_STATE: This action is unavailable in the current state. Refresh status to continue.
errors.default: The request could not be completed. Your inputs are retained; refresh status before trying again.
errors.PRODUCT_VIDEO_IMAGE_INVALID: Choose a valid JPG/PNG, up to 10 MB and 20 megapixels.
errors.INSUFFICIENT_AI_CREDIT: There are not enough credits for all scenes. Add credits or reduce the scene count, then update the storyboard.
errors.AI_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The AI service is unavailable. Keep your brief and try again later.
errors.PRODUCT_VIDEO_QUOTE_EXPIRED: This quote expired. Update the storyboard to see a new quote.
errors.PRODUCT_VIDEO_PLAN_STALE: The storyboard changed in another session. Refresh status before continuing.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have access to this data.
